description: Get ocean floor depth (metres, negative values below sea level) at a lat/lon coordinate using the GEBCO 2020 global bathymetric dataset (450m resolution). Returns depth in metres; negative values indicate depth below sea level, positive values indicate land elevation above sea level. Use for marine navigation planning, submarine cable routing, oceanographic research, and coastal engineering. MIT licence, no auth, no upstream cost.

lat.description: Latitude of the ocean/sea point (-90 to 90)

lon.description: Longitude of the ocean/sea point (-180 to 180)

name: opentopodata.elevation.ocean

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Open Topo Data — Ocean Depth (Bathymetry)
